rule.name: NullableLibraryResult
rule.message: This call returns null as a normal answer (a package without manifest metadata has no version, a request without that query string, header, parameter, path info or session has none), but the result is dereferenced without a null check, so the code throws a NullPointerException for those inputs. Check it first (String version = pkg.getImplementationVersion(); if (version != null) ...), or fall back with Objects.requireNonNullElse(request.getParameter(name), ""). An exception fits when the receiver is known to have the value.
